title: One whole read for the fleet
description: Nine machines that need the graph of the whole workspace read it once: the machine that finds no complete head of the fleet claims the whole read (the claim key names the registry identity and the platform, never a path, a root or a host name), reads, seals and offers its generation; every other machine waits with progress and a bound and then fetches the complete head instead of reading. A head its producer knew incomplete (a wave of the read that still goes on) is not fetched by a machine that waits; a head built by other code is not taken. When the claim holder stops renewing its lease the next machine takes over; every fleet fault, a missing upload right and the end of the bound end in a local read, so a broken cache never fails or hangs a read. A machine that already holds a sealed generation of its own reads the difference alone: the gate applies to a machine without one. A machine with less memory than a whole read wants (below the serving size of the generation exchange) does not claim at once: it gives the machines with more memory the declared delay to claim and read, and claims only when no head and no claim appeared.

fetching.en: graph: the fleet holds a complete generation of the whole workspace ({owners} projects, {age} min old): fetching it instead of reading
fetching.de: Graph: Die Flotte hält eine vollständige Generation des ganzen Arbeitsbereichs ({owners} Projekte, {age} Min. alt): sie wird geladen statt gelesen

claimed.en: graph: no machine holds a complete generation of the whole workspace and none is reading it: this machine reads it once and offers it to the fleet
claimed.de: Graph: Keine Maschine hält eine vollständige Generation des ganzen Arbeitsbereichs und keine liest sie: diese Maschine liest sie einmal und bietet sie der Flotte an

waiting.en: graph: {by} is reading the whole workspace, waiting for its generation instead of reading again ({seconds} s of at most {limit} min{progress})
waiting.de: Graph: {by} liest den ganzen Arbeitsbereich, die Generation wird abgewartet statt nochmals gelesen ({seconds} s von höchstens {limit} Min.{progress})

progress.en: ; its newest head holds {owners} projects, {stale} still stale
progress.de: ; sein neuester Stand hält {owners} Projekte, {stale} noch veraltet

takenOver.en: graph: the machine that was reading the whole workspace stopped renewing its claim: this machine takes the read over
takenOver.de: Graph: Die Maschine, die den ganzen Arbeitsbereich gelesen hat, erneuert ihren Anspruch nicht mehr: diese Maschine übernimmt das Lesen

expired.en: graph: waited {minutes} min for the whole read of {by} without a complete generation: reading here
expired.de: Graph: {minutes} Min. auf das Lesen von {by} gewartet ohne vollständige Generation: es wird hier gelesen

unreachable.en: graph: the fleet exchange of the whole workspace is not usable ({reason}): reading here
unreachable.de: Graph: Der Flotten-Austausch des ganzen Arbeitsbereichs ist nicht nutzbar ({reason}): es wird hier gelesen

yielding.en: graph: this machine has less memory than a whole read wants: machines with more memory get {minutes} min to read it first
yielding.de: Graph: Diese Maschine hat weniger Speicher als ein ganzes Lesen braucht: Maschinen mit mehr Speicher lesen zuerst, {minutes} Min. lang
